q_vocab_c1_01_001.question: Que 'cabe destacar' signifier dans academic writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_001.correct: it is worth noting / it should be highlighted
q_vocab_c1_01_001.explanation: 'Cabe destacar' est a formel academic expression sens 'il est worth noting' ou 'il devrait être highlighted'. Il est utilisé pour draw Le/La reader's attention à an important point dans formel writing.

q_vocab_c1_01_002.question: Que 'en lo que respecta a' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_01_002.correct: with regard to / as far as ... is concerned
q_vocab_c1_01_002.explanation: 'En lo que respecta a' signifie 'avec regard à' ou 'as far as ... est concerned'. Il est a formel linking phrase used à introduce a specific topic ou aspect within academic discourse.

q_vocab_c1_01_003.question: A modo de ___, podemos afirmar que los resultados confirman la hipótesis inicial.
q_vocab_c1_01_003.explanation: 'A modo de conclusión' signifie 'par way de conclusion'. Ce phrase est utilisé dans academic papers à signal Le/La final summary ou closing remarks de an argument.

q_vocab_c1_01_004.question: Que 'según los datos' signifier dans a research context?
q_vocab_c1_01_004.explanation: 'Según los datos' signifie 'according à Le/La data'. Il est utilisé dans academic writing à introduce evidence-based claims supported par empirical findings.

q_vocab_c1_01_005.question: Que 'no obstante' signifier dans formel writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_005.explanation: 'No obstante' est a formel connector sens 'nevertheless' ou 'cependant'. Il introduces a contrasting idea et est considered more elevated dans register than 'pero' ou 'sin embargo'.

q_vocab_c1_01_006.question: dans light de Le/La above
q_vocab_c1_01_006.correct: a la luz de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_01_006.explanation: 'Dans light de Le/La above' translates à 'a la luz de lo anterior' en espagnol. Ce academic phrase refers back à previously stated evidence ou arguments à support a nouveau point.

q_vocab_c1_01_007.question: Que 'dicho de otro modo' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_01_007.explanation: 'Dicho de otro modo' signifie 'dans other mots' ou 'put differently'. Il est utilisé dans academic texts à rephrase ou clarify a complex idea pour Le/La reader.

q_vocab_c1_01_008.question: cabe señalar
q_vocab_c1_01_008.explanation: 'Cabe señalar' signifie 'il devrait être pointed out'. Like 'cabe destacar', il uses Le/La impersonal verbe 'caber' dans son sense de 'à être fitting' à introduce noteworthy information.

q_vocab_c1_01_009.question: Vous sont writing a thesis introduction et need à present Le/La scope de votre research. Quel expression est la plupart appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_01_009.correct: El presente estudio se centra en analizar los factores que inciden en el fenómeno.
wrong: Este trabajo habla de cosas interesantes.
Voy a escribir sobre un tema que me gusta.
Aquí explico lo que pienso del asunto.
q_vocab_c1_01_009.explanation: 'El presente estudio se centra en' signifie 'Le/La present study focuses sur'. C'est Le/La standard formel register expected dans academic thesis introductions, using precise et impersonal langue.

q_vocab_c1_01_010.question: Vous need à acknowledge a limitation dans votre research methodology. Quel phrasing demonstrates appropriate academic register?
q_vocab_c1_01_010.correct: Si bien este estudio presenta ciertas limitaciones metodológicas, los hallazgos resultan significativos.
wrong: El estudio tiene problemas pero no importa mucho.
Los errores del estudio no son tan graves como parecen.
Hay fallos pero los resultados son buenos de todas formas.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.explanation: 'Si bien' (bien que) combined avec 'limitaciones metodológicas' (methodological limitations) et 'hallazgos significativos' (significant findings) represents Le/La balanced, objective tone required dans academic writing quand addressing study limitations.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.context: Writing the limitations section of a research paper

q_vocab_c1_02_001.question: Que 'la patología' signifier dans medical terminology?
q_vocab_c1_02_001.explanation: 'La patología' signifie 'pathology', referring à Le/La study de diseases ou à a disease condition itself. Dans clinical settings, il encompasses Le/La causes, mechanisms, et effects de diseases.

q_vocab_c1_02_002.question: El tribunal dictó una ___ absolutoria a favor del acusado.
q_vocab_c1_02_002.explanation: 'Sentencia absolutoria' signifie 'acquittal ruling'. Le/La phrase signifie 'Le/La court issued an acquittal ruling dans favor de Le/La defendant.' Dans legal terminology, 'sentencia' se réfère à a judicial ruling ou verdict.

q_vocab_c1_02_003.question: Que 'el ensayo clínico' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_02_003.explanation: 'El ensayo clínico' signifie 'clinical trial', a research study conducted à evaluate Le/La safety et efficacy de medical treatments, drugs, ou devices sur human participants.

q_vocab_c1_02_004.question: Que 'la jurisprudencia' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_02_004.explanation: 'La jurisprudencia' signifie 'jurisprudence' ou 'case law', Le/La body de legal principles established through précédent court decisions Cela guides future judicial rulings.

q_vocab_c1_02_005.question: genome
q_vocab_c1_02_005.explanation: 'Genome' translates à 'el genoma' en espagnol. Il se réfère à Le/La complete set de genetic material present dans an organism. 'El gen' est a single gene, pendant que 'la genética' est Le/La field de genetics.

q_vocab_c1_02_006.question: Que 'el peritaje' signifier dans a legal ou professional context?
q_vocab_c1_02_006.explanation: 'El peritaje' signifie 'expert assessment' ou 'forensic evaluation', a technical report prepared par a qualified specialist ('perito') à provide evidence ou informed opinion dans legal ou professional matters.

q_vocab_c1_02_007.question: A research team publishes findings à propos de a nouveau treatment pour autoimmune diseases. Quel term décrit Le/La body's immune system attacking son own cells?
q_vocab_c1_02_007.correct: una enfermedad autoinmune: el sistema inmunitario ataca los tejidos propios del organismo
wrong: una alergia: el cuerpo reacciona a sustancias externas
una infección: bacterias invaden el cuerpo
una intoxicación: el cuerpo absorbe sustancias tóxicas
q_vocab_c1_02_007.explanation: 'Enfermedad autoinmune' signifie 'autoimmune disease'. Le/La immune system ('sistema inmunitario') mistakenly attacks Le/La body's own healthy tissues ('tejidos propios'), unlike allergies ou infections quel involve external agents.

q_vocab_c1_02_008.question: Que 'el protocolo' signifier dans a scientific ou diplomatic context?
q_vocab_c1_02_008.explanation: 'El protocolo' signifie 'protocol', a formel set de rules ou established procedures governing conduct dans official, scientific, ou diplomatic settings. Dans research, il defines Le/La methodology et steps de an experiment.

q_vocab_c1_02_009.question: la nanotecnología
q_vocab_c1_02_009.explanation: 'La nanotecnología' signifie 'nanotechnology', Le/La branch de technology dealing avec Le/La manipulation de matter à an atomic ou molecular scale, typiquement below 100 nanometers.

q_vocab_c1_02_010.question: A lawyer argues Cela a contract clause est unenforceable parce que one party signed under duress. Quel legal concept applies?
q_vocab_c1_02_010.correct: Vicio del consentimiento: la voluntad de una de las partes fue coaccionada.
wrong: Prescripción: el contrato ha expirado por el paso del tiempo.
Novación: el contrato fue sustituido por uno nuevo.
Subrogación: una tercera parte asumió las obligaciones.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.explanation: 'Vicio del consentimiento' signifie 'defect de consent'. Quand a party signs a contract under 'coacción' (duress), Le/La agreement peut être voided parce que genuine free sera était absent. Ceci est un fundamental principle dans contract law.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.context: Civil court hearing on contract validity

q_vocab_c1_03_001.question: Quel est Le/La key difference between 'lograr' et 'conseguir'?
q_vocab_c1_03_001.correct: 'Lograr' emphasizes achieving a goal through effort; 'conseguir' means to obtain or manage to do something
wrong: They are completely identical in all contexts
'Lograr' means to lose and 'conseguir' means to win
q_vocab_c1_03_001.explanation: Pendant que les deux peut signifier 'à achieve', 'lograr' carries a stronger connotation de accomplishment après sustained effort (lograr un sueño = achieve a dream), whereas 'conseguir' est broader, sens à obtain ou manage à do something (conseguir entradas = get tickets).

q_vocab_c1_03_002.question: Que 'carecer de' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_03_002.correct: to lack / to be devoid of
q_vocab_c1_03_002.explanation: 'Carecer de' signifie 'à lack' ou 'à être devoid de'. Il est a formel verbe used pour exprimer Le/La absence de something: 'El informe carece de evidencia sólida' (Le/La report lacks solid evidence).

q_vocab_c1_03_003.question: El candidato ___ un puesto de trabajo acorde con su experiencia profesional.
q_vocab_c1_03_003.explanation: 'Solicitar' signifie 'à apply pour' ou 'à formally request', used dans professional et administrative contexts. 'Pedir' est a more general et informel 'pour demander pour', pendant que 'solicitar' implies a formel process tel que job applications ou official requests.

q_vocab_c1_03_004.question: Quel est Le/La nuanced difference between 'realizar' et 'hacer'?
q_vocab_c1_03_004.correct: 'Realizar' implies carrying out something planned or significant; 'hacer' is the general verb for 'to do/make'
wrong: 'Realizar' means to make real and 'hacer' means to destroy
They are exact synonyms with no difference
'Realizar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_03_004.explanation: 'Realizar' suggests executing something avec deliberation et importance (realizar una investigación = conduct a study), pendant que 'hacer' est Le/La everyday, tous-purpose verbe pour doing ou making things. Using 'realizar' elevates Le/La register.

q_vocab_c1_03_005.question: Que 'matizar' signifier dans Le/La context de argumentation?
q_vocab_c1_03_005.correct: to qualify / to nuance / to add subtle distinctions
q_vocab_c1_03_005.explanation: 'Matizar' signifie 'à qualify' ou 'à add nuance'. Dans academic ou professional discourse, il se réfère à refining a statement par adding subtle distinctions ou clarifications, e.g., 'Conviene matizar esta afirmación' (Ce statement devrait être qualified).

q_vocab_c1_03_006.question: à undermine / à weaken
q_vocab_c1_03_006.explanation: 'À undermine' translates à 'socavar' en espagnol. Il signifie à weaken ou erode something gradually, souvent used figuratively: 'socavar la confianza' (à undermine trust). Ne pas confuse avec 'subrayar' (à underline).

q_vocab_c1_03_007.question: Quel est Le/La difference between 'aludir a' et 'referirse a'?
q_vocab_c1_03_007.correct: 'Aludir a' means to allude to (indirectly); 'referirse a' means to refer to (directly)
wrong: They are identical in meaning and usage
'Aludir a' is more direct than 'referirse a'
'Aludir a' means to hallucinate about something
q_vocab_c1_03_007.explanation: 'Aludir a' implies an indirect ou subtle reference (El autor alude a la guerra sin mencionarla = Le/La author alludes à Le/La war sans mentioning il), pendant que 'referirse a' est a direct et explicit reference à something.

q_vocab_c1_03_008.question: prescindir de
q_vocab_c1_03_008.correct: to do without / to dispense with
q_vocab_c1_03_008.explanation: 'Prescindir de' signifie 'à do sans' ou 'à dispense avec'. Il exprime deliberately choosing à omit ou forgo something: 'Podemos prescindir de estos datos' (We peut do sans Ce data).

q_vocab_c1_03_009.question: Vous sont editing a colleague's report et notice ils used 'detentar' à signifier 'à hold a position legitimately'. Est Ce usage correct?
q_vocab_c1_03_009.correct: No, 'detentar' implies holding power illegitimately; the correct word is 'ostentar' or 'ocupar'.
wrong: Yes, 'detentar' is the only correct verb for holding any position.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.explanation: 'Detentar' specifically signifie à hold power ou a position illegitimately ou sans proper right, pendant que 'ostentar' ou 'ocupar' sont utilisés pour legitimate office-holding. Ceci est un frequently confused pair even among native speakers.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.context: Editing a professional report for publication

q_vocab_c1_03_010.question: A novelist wants à convey Cela a character views Le/La world avec excessive optimism Cela ignores reality. Quel verbe best captures Ce nuance?
q_vocab_c1_03_010.correct: 'Idealizar': atribuir cualidades de perfección a algo que no las tiene.
wrong: 'Optimizar': mejorar algo para hacerlo más eficiente.
'Visualizar': formar una imagen mental de algo.
'Imaginar': crear algo ficticio en la mente.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.explanation: 'Idealizar' signifie 'à idealize', attributing unrealistically perfect qualities à something ou someone. Il implies a distortion de reality through an overly positive lens, whereas 'imaginar' simply signifie à envision, et 'optimizar' signifie à optimize pour efficiency.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.context: Literary character analysis in a creative writing workshop

q_vocab_c1_04_001.question: Que 'Le saluda atentamente' signifier à Le/La end de a formel letter?
q_vocab_c1_04_001.explanation: 'Le saluda atentamente' est a standard formel closing en espagnol correspondence, equivalent à 'Yours sincerely' ou 'Yours faithfully'. Il est utilisé dans business et official letters.

q_vocab_c1_04_002.question: Me dirijo a usted con el fin de ___ información sobre el programa de becas.
q_vocab_c1_04_002.explanation: 'Solicitar' (à formally request) est Le/La appropriate verbe dans formel correspondence. 'Me dirijo a usted con el fin de solicitar' signifie 'I am writing à vous dans order à request'. 'Pedir' serait too informel pour Ce register.

q_vocab_c1_04_003.question: Que 'Estimado/a señor/a' signifier as a formel salutation?
q_vocab_c1_04_003.explanation: 'Estimado/a señor/a' est Le/La standard formel salutation en espagnol letters et emails, equivalent à 'Dear Sir/Madam'. 'Estimado' literally signifie 'esteemed' mais functions as Le/La conventional poli salutation.

q_vocab_c1_04_004.question: Que 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_04_004.correct: I apologize for the inconvenience caused
wrong: I am sorry for the occasion
q_vocab_c1_04_004.explanation: 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' est a formel apology sens 'I apologize pour Le/La inconvenience caused'. Il est couramment used dans business correspondence et customer service communications.

q_vocab_c1_04_005.question: I serait grateful si vous pourrait
q_vocab_c1_04_005.explanation: 'I serait grateful si vous pourrait' translates à 'Le agradecería que' suivi de Le/La subjonctif mood. Ceci est un poli hedging expression used dans formel requests, considered more courteous than direct imperatives.

q_vocab_c1_04_006.question: Que 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_04_006.correct: I remain at your disposal for any clarification
wrong: I am quiet about the situation for now
I stay at the position of clarification
I remain disposed to any clearing
q_vocab_c1_04_006.explanation: 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' est a formel closing phrase dans business correspondence sens 'I remain à votre disposal pour n'importe quel clarification'. Il signals willingness à provide further information.

q_vocab_c1_04_007.question: Vous sont writing a formel complaint à a company à propos de defective merchandise. Quel opening est la plupart appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_04_007.correct: Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad con el producto recibido.
wrong: Oigan, el producto que me mandaron está roto.
Quiero quejarme porque lo que compré no sirve.
Hola, tengo un problema con algo que pedí.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.explanation: 'Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad' signifie 'I am writing à vous pour exprimer my dissatisfaction'. Ce formel register avec 'disconformidad' (dissatisfaction) est appropriate pour official complaints, unlike Le/La informel alternatives.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.context: Formal written complaint to a company

q_vocab_c1_04_008.question: Que 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_04_008.correct: We kindly ask that you excuse the delay
wrong: We beg for your pardon for the damage
q_vocab_c1_04_008.explanation: 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' uses Le/La formel 'rogar' (à request/beseech) avec subjonctif 'disculpen' à politely ask forgiveness pour a delay. 'Rogar' elevates Le/La register beyond simply 'pedir disculpas'.

q_vocab_c1_04_009.question: sin perjuicio de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_04_009.correct: without prejudice to the foregoing / notwithstanding the above
q_vocab_c1_04_009.explanation: 'Sin perjuicio de lo anterior' est a formel legal et administrative expression sens 'sans prejudice à Le/La foregoing' ou 'notwithstanding Le/La above'. Il est utilisé pour state Cela a nouveau point ne pas invalidate previously mentioned terms.

q_vocab_c1_04_010.question: Vous sont drafting an email à a government ministry requesting an extension pour a grant application deadline. Quel phrasing demonstrates Le/La appropriate formel hedging langue?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.correct: Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de ampliar el plazo de presentación de solicitudes.
wrong: Necesito más tiempo, así que extienda la fecha.
Quiero que me den más días para entregar todo.
Oiga, no me da tiempo, ¿puede alargar el plazo?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.explanation: 'Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de' est an extremely formel construction sens 'Serait vous être donc kind as à consider Le/La possibility de'. Ce multi-layered hedging (conditionnel + poli phrase + possibility) montre Le/La highest level de formel register appropriate pour government correspondence.
q_vocab_c1_04_010.context: Formal correspondence with a government ministry

q_vocab_c1_05_001.question: Que 'mola' signifier en espagnol colloquial speech?
q_vocab_c1_05_001.explanation: 'Mola' vient de le verbe 'molar', quel est Espagnol slang (primarily dans Spain) sens 'à être cool' ou 'à être awesome'. '¡Esa película mola mucho!' signifie 'Cela movie est really cool!'

q_vocab_c1_05_002.question: Que 'currar' signifier dans informel Espagnol?
q_vocab_c1_05_002.explanation: 'Currar' est Espagnol slang sens 'à work'. 'El curro' est Le/La slang nom pour 'work/job'. 'Estoy currando' signifie 'I'm working'. C'est très commun dans everyday speech dans Spain.

q_vocab_c1_05_003.question: Se me quedó la mente en ___ durante el examen y no pude responder nada.
q_vocab_c1_05_003.explanation: 'Quedarse en blanco' signifie 'à go blank' ou 'à draw a blank'. Le/La full expression décrit Le/La moment quand votre mind suddenly empties et vous ne peut pas remember anything, surtout pendant stressful situations like exams.

q_vocab_c1_05_004.question: Que 'flipar' signifier dans colloquial Espagnol?
q_vocab_c1_05_004.correct: to be amazed / to freak out / to be shocked
q_vocab_c1_05_004.explanation: 'Flipar' signifie 'à être amazed' ou 'à freak out' (dans l'un ou l'autre a positive ou negative sense). '¡Estoy flipando!' peut signifier 'I peut't believe il!' ou 'I'm blown away!' Il originated de Anglais 'à flip out'.

q_vocab_c1_05_005.question: Que 'pasarlo bomba' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_05_005.correct: to have a blast / to have a great time
wrong: to throw a bomb at a party
q_vocab_c1_05_005.explanation: 'Pasarlo bomba' est a colloquial expression sens 'à avoir a blast' ou 'à avoir an amazing temps'. 'Lo pasamos bomba en la fiesta' signifie 'We avait a blast à Le/La party'. Le/La 'bomba' metaphorically suggests explosive fun.

q_vocab_c1_05_006.question: à être fed up / à être sick de something
q_vocab_c1_05_006.explanation: 'À être fed up' translates à 'estar harto/a'. 'Estoy harto de esperar' signifie 'I'm fed up avec waiting'. Pendant que 'lleno' signifie physically full, 'harto' conveys emotional saturation et frustration.

q_vocab_c1_05_007.question: Que 'tío/tía' signifier quand used as slang (not literally)?
q_vocab_c1_05_007.correct: dude / mate / pal (informal way to address someone)
wrong: a rude way to address a stranger
a formal title for elderly people
q_vocab_c1_05_007.explanation: 'Tío/tía' literally signifie 'uncle/aunt' mais dans colloquial Espagnol (surtout dans Spain), il functions as 'dude', 'mate', ou 'pal'. '¡Eh, tío, ¿qué tal?!' signifie 'Hey dude, comment's il going?!'

q_vocab_c1_05_008.question: ir de cañas
q_vocab_c1_05_008.correct: to go out for beers / to go bar-hopping for draft beers
wrong: to go to the sugar cane fields
q_vocab_c1_05_008.explanation: 'Ir de cañas' signifie 'à go out pour beers', specifically petit draft beers ('cañas'). Il est a quintessential Espagnol social activity involving visiting several bars et having a petit beer à chaque one.

q_vocab_c1_05_009.question: Votre ami espagnol dit '¡Qué fuerte!' après avoir appris une nouvelle surprenante. Quel registre et quel sens cette expression exprime-t-elle ?
q_vocab_c1_05_009.correct: C'est une exclamation familière qui exprime le choc ou l'incrédulité, et qui signifie « Pas possible ! » ou « C'est dingue ! »
wrong: C'est une expression soutenue qui signifie que la nouvelle est physiquement forte.
Cela signifie que la nouvelle concerne quelqu'un de très puissant.
C'est un terme médical qui signifie que la personne se sent forte.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.explanation: '¡Qué fuerte!' est une exclamation familière très courante en Espagne, utilisée pour exprimer la surprise, le choc ou l'incrédulité. Littéralement « Comme c'est fort ! », elle fonctionne comme « Pas possible ! » ou « C'est dingue ! » dans une conversation informelle.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.context: Casual conversation reacting to surprising news

q_vocab_c1_05_010.question: A group de friends est planning a Saturday nuit out. One says: 'Vamos a ir de marcha y lo vamos a pasar genial.' Que Ce signifier et que register est il?
q_vocab_c1_05_010.correct: Informal register: 'We're going to go out partying and we're going to have a great time.'
wrong: Formal register: 'We are going on a march and it will be wonderful.'
Neutral register: 'We are leaving on a journey and will arrive safely.'
Military register: 'We are starting a march and will complete it successfully.'
q_vocab_c1_05_010.explanation: 'Ir de marcha' est colloquial pour 'à go out partying' ou 'à go out sur Le/La town'. Combined avec 'pasarlo genial' (à avoir a great temps), C'est typical informel youth langue dans Spain pour planning a nuit out.
q_vocab_c1_05_010.context: Friends making weekend plans via group chat

q_vocab_c1_06_001.question: Que Le/La proverb 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_06_001.correct: Every cloud has a silver lining
wrong: There is no evil that comes from good
Bad things never happen to good people
No harm comes without a warning
q_vocab_c1_06_001.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' literally signifie 'Il n'y a pas de mauvais Cela ne pas come pour bon'. Il est equivalent à 'Chaque cloud a a silver lining', expressing Le/La idea Cela something positive peut emerge de negative situations.

q_vocab_c1_06_002.question: Más vale ___ que nunca, así que empecemos el proyecto ahora.
q_vocab_c1_06_002.explanation: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' signifie 'Better late than jamais'. Le/La phrase signifie 'Better late than jamais, donc let's start Le/La project maintenant.' Ce proverb encourages action even quand delayed.

q_vocab_c1_06_003.question: Que 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_06_003.correct: The early bird catches the worm / God helps those who rise early
wrong: God helps those who are mature
q_vocab_c1_06_003.explanation: 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' literally signifie 'God helps ceux qui rise early'. Le verbe 'madrugar' signifie 'à get up early'. Il est equivalent à Le/La Anglais proverb 'Le/La early bird catches Le/La worm', emphasizing diligence.

q_vocab_c1_06_004.question: Que 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_06_004.correct: Silence is golden / It's better to keep quiet
wrong: You should close your mouth when flies are near
Insects are attracted to open mouths
q_vocab_c1_06_004.explanation: 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' literally signifie 'Flies ne pas enter a closed mouth'. Il advises discretion et Le/La wisdom de keeping quiet à avoid trouble, similaire à 'Silence est golden'.

q_vocab_c1_06_005.question: ne pas look a gift horse dans Le/La mouth
q_vocab_c1_06_005.correct: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente
wrong: No mires al caballo en la boca del regalo
El caballo del regalo tiene dientes malos
Regalar un caballo es mirar sus dientes
q_vocab_c1_06_005.explanation: 'A caballo regalado no le mires el diente' est Le/La exact Espagnol equivalent de 'Ne pas look a gift horse dans Le/La mouth'. Les deux proverbs advise being grateful pour gifts sans criticizing leur quality.

q_vocab_c1_06_006.question: Que 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_06_006.correct: He who grasps at too much loses everything / Jack of all trades, master of none
wrong: Those who hug too much squeeze too little
Big hugs are never tight enough
q_vocab_c1_06_006.explanation: 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' literally signifie 'Qui embraces beaucoup, squeezes peu'. Il warns against taking sur too beaucoup tasks ou responsibilities à once, as aucun sera être done well.

q_vocab_c1_06_007.question: A colleague a été complaining à propos de leur job mais refuses à look pour a nouveau one. Quel proverb serait la plupart fitting advice?
q_vocab_c1_06_007.correct: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' -- You have to take risks to achieve results.
wrong: 'Más vale pájaro en mano que ciento volando' -- Keep what you already have.
'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' -- Ignore the problem.
'Perro ladrador, poco mordedor' -- The complaints are harmless.
q_vocab_c1_06_007.explanation: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' signifie 'Nothing ventured, nothing gained'. Il encourages someone à take calculated risks rather than remaining dans an unsatisfactory situation, quel est appropriate advice pour someone afraid à seek change.
q_vocab_c1_06_007.context: Giving career advice to a dissatisfied friend

q_vocab_c1_06_008.question: Que 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_06_008.correct: You are known by the company you keep / Tell me who your friends are and I'll tell you who you are
wrong: Tell me where you walk and I'll tell you who you are
Walk with me and I'll know your name
Show me your path and I'll show you mine
q_vocab_c1_06_008.explanation: 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' literally signifie 'Tell me qui vous walk avec et I'll tell vous qui vous sont'. Il emphasizes Cela personnes sont judged par leur associations et friendships.

q_vocab_c1_06_009.question: Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente
q_vocab_c1_06_009.correct: Out of sight, out of mind
wrong: Eyes that don't see have no feelings
The heart cannot see what the eyes feel
q_vocab_c1_06_009.explanation: 'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' literally signifie 'Eyes Cela ne pas see, heart Cela ne pas feel'. Il est equivalent à 'Out de sight, out de mind', suggesting Cela not knowing à propos de something prevents emotional pain.

q_vocab_c1_06_010.question: A student fails an exam mais discovers Cela Le/La failure motivated them à change leur study habits, leading à beaucoup better grades. Quel proverb perfectly décrit Ce situation?
q_vocab_c1_06_010.correct: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' -- The setback ultimately led to improvement.
wrong: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' -- They studied late but passed.
'El saber no ocupa lugar' -- Knowledge takes up no space.
'A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan' -- Smart students need fewer words.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' (Chaque cloud a a silver lining) perfectly décrit comment a negative event (failing Le/La exam) led à a positive outcome (improved study habits et better grades). Le/La proverb captures Le/La transformative potential de adversity.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.context: Reflecting on academic setbacks and personal growth

q_vocab_c1_07_001.question: Que 'el rendimiento' signifier dans a business context?
q_vocab_c1_07_001.explanation: 'El rendimiento' dans business signifie 'performance', 'yield', ou 'productivity'. 'El rendimiento del equipo' signifie 'team performance', et 'rendimiento de la inversión' signifie 'return sur investment'.

q_vocab_c1_07_002.question: Que 'el flujo de trabajo' signifier dans a professional setting?
wrong: the flow of water at work
q_vocab_c1_07_002.explanation: 'El flujo de trabajo' signifie 'workflow', Le/La sequence de processes through quel a piece de work passes de initiation à completion. Il est a standard term dans project management et business operations.

q_vocab_c1_07_003.question: La empresa necesita ___ su modelo de negocio para adaptarse al mercado digital.
q_vocab_c1_07_003.explanation: 'Reestructurar' signifie 'à restructure', specifically referring à reorganizing a company's operations, finances, ou strategy. Le/La phrase signifie 'Le/La company needs à restructure son business model à adapt à Le/La digital market.'

q_vocab_c1_07_004.question: Que 'la escalabilidad' signifier dans Il et business?
q_vocab_c1_07_004.explanation: 'La escalabilidad' signifie 'scalability', Le/La capacity de a system, network, ou business à handle growing amounts de work ou à expand. Il est a critical concept dans technology startups et software development.

q_vocab_c1_07_005.question: Que 'el titular' signifier dans journalism?
q_vocab_c1_07_005.explanation: 'El titular' dans journalism signifie 'headline', Le/La title de a newspaper article designed à capture Le/La reader's attention. Il peut aussi signifier 'title holder' dans other contexts, mais dans media, il se réfère à headlines.

q_vocab_c1_07_006.question: stakeholder
q_vocab_c1_07_006.explanation: 'Stakeholder' translates à 'la parte interesada' ou 'el interesado' en espagnol. Unlike 'accionista' (shareholder), a stakeholder est n'importe quel party avec an interest dans ou affected par a business ou project.

q_vocab_c1_07_007.question: Que 'externalizar' signifier dans business terminology?
q_vocab_c1_07_007.explanation: 'Externalizar' signifie 'à outsource', Le/La practice de contracting business processes ou functions à external companies. 'La empresa decidió externalizar el servicio de atención al cliente' signifie 'Le/La company decided à outsource customer service'.

q_vocab_c1_07_008.question: la competencia desleal
q_vocab_c1_07_008.explanation: 'La competencia desleal' signifie 'unfair competition', business practices Cela sont deceptive, fraudulent, ou otherwise unfair à competitors. Il est a legal concept dans commercial law.

q_vocab_c1_07_009.question: A software development team est discussing comment handle a product launch Cela keeps getting delayed. Le/La project manager suggests adopting a nouveau approach. Quel professional term décrit Ce methodology?
q_vocab_c1_07_009.correct: Implementar una metodología ágil para iterar más rápidamente.
wrong: Cancelar el proyecto y empezar uno nuevo.
Despedir a todos los desarrolladores del equipo.
Ignorar los plazos y lanzar cuando esté listo.
q_vocab_c1_07_009.explanation: 'Metodología ágil' signifie 'agile methodology', an iterative approach à project management et software development Cela delivers work dans petit increments. 'Iterar' signifie 'à iterate', making incremental improvements through repeated cycles.

q_vocab_c1_07_010.question: A journalist needs à protect Le/La identity de a source qui provided sensitive information à propos de corporate corruption. Quel professional principle applies?
q_vocab_c1_07_010.correct: El secreto profesional obliga a proteger la identidad de las fuentes confidenciales.
wrong: La ley obliga a revelar todas las fuentes en cualquier caso.
El periodista debe publicar el nombre completo de la fuente.
Las fuentes anónimas no son válidas en el periodismo.
q_vocab_c1_07_010.explanation: 'El secreto profesional' signifie 'professional secrecy' ou 'source protection'. Dans journalism, Ce ethical principle protects Le/La identity de confidential sources ('fuentes confidenciales'), quel est fundamental à press freedom et investigative reporting.

q_vocab_c1_08_001.question: Que 'la trascendencia' signifier dans philosophical discourse?
q_vocab_c1_08_001.explanation: 'La trascendencia' signifie 'transcendence' ou 'far-reaching significance'. Dans philosophy, il se réfère à Le/La aspect de existence Cela goes beyond Le/La ordinary ou physical realm. Dans everyday usage, il signifie lasting importance.

q_vocab_c1_08_002.question: El concepto de ___ ha sido debatido por filósofos durante siglos.
q_vocab_c1_08_002.explanation: 'Identidad' signifie 'identity'. Le/La phrase signifie 'Le/La concept de identity a été debated par philosophers pour centuries.' Identity est a core abstract concept dans philosophy, psychology, et sociology.

q_vocab_c1_08_003.question: Que 'el paradigma' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_08_003.correct: paradigm / model of thought or understanding
q_vocab_c1_08_003.explanation: 'El paradigma' signifie 'paradigm', a framework de thought, a model de understanding, ou a set de accepted beliefs Cela defines a field. 'Un cambio de paradigma' (a paradigm shift) se réfère à a fundamental change dans approach ou underlying assumptions.

q_vocab_c1_08_004.question: Que 'la conciencia' signifier quand used as an abstract concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_004.explanation: 'La conciencia' as an abstract concept a dual sens: 'consciousness' (philosophical awareness de existence) et 'conscience' (moral awareness). 'Tomar conciencia' signifie 'à become aware' ou 'à raise awareness'.

q_vocab_c1_08_005.question: inherent / intrinsic
q_vocab_c1_08_005.explanation: 'Inherent' ou 'intrinsic' translates à 'intrínseco' en espagnol. Il décrit a quality Cela est essential et permanent, belonging naturally à something: 'el valor intrínseco' (intrinsic value).

q_vocab_c1_08_006.question: Que signifie 'la equidad', et en quoi diffère-t-elle de 'la igualdad' ?
q_vocab_c1_08_006.correct: l'équité ; elle consiste à donner à chacun ce dont il a besoin, tandis que 'igualdad' consiste à donner la même chose à tout le monde
wrong: Ce sont deux notions strictement identiques
'Equidad' signifie faire de l'équitation et 'igualdad' signifie égalité
'Equidad' est un terme économique et 'igualdad' est uniquement un terme social
q_vocab_c1_08_006.explanation: 'La equidad' signifie « l'équité », c'est-à-dire répartir les ressources selon les besoins de chacun pour parvenir à des résultats justes. 'La igualdad' signifie « l'égalité », traiter tout le monde de la même façon. Cette distinction est essentielle dans le discours sur la justice sociale.

q_vocab_c1_08_007.question: A philosopher argues Cela human freedom est inseparable de responsibility. Quel abstract concept est central à Ce argument?
q_vocab_c1_08_007.correct: La autonomía: la capacidad del individuo de gobernarse a sí mismo implica asumir las consecuencias de sus actos.
wrong: La dependencia: el ser humano depende de otros para actuar.
La obediencia: la libertad consiste en seguir las reglas establecidas.
La indiferencia: la libertad y la responsabilidad no están relacionadas.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.explanation: 'La autonomía' signifie 'autonomy', Le/La capacity pour self-governance. Le/La philosophical connection between freedom et responsibility est rooted dans autonomy: being free à choose signifie being accountable pour ceux choices.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.context: Philosophy seminar on existentialism and ethics

q_vocab_c1_08_008.question: Que 'la resiliencia' signifier as an abstract psychological concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_008.correct: resilience / the ability to recover from adversity
q_vocab_c1_08_008.explanation: 'La resiliencia' signifie 'resilience', Le/La psychological capacity à recover de difficulties et adapt à challenging circumstances. Il a become a central concept dans psychology, education, et personal development.

q_vocab_c1_08_009.question: la alteridad
q_vocab_c1_08_009.correct: otherness / the quality of being different or other
q_vocab_c1_08_009.explanation: 'La alteridad' signifie 'otherness', a philosophical concept Cela se réfère à Le/La recognition de Le/La 'other' as fundamentally différent de oneself. Il est central à ethics, particularly dans Le/La philosophy de Emmanuel Levinas.

q_vocab_c1_08_010.question: Two debaters sont discussing whether morality est universal ou culturally determined. Quel pair de abstract concepts frames Ce debate?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.correct: El universalismo moral frente al relativismo cultural: ¿existen valores absolutos o dependen del contexto?
wrong: El capitalismo frente al socialismo: ¿quién tiene más dinero?
El optimismo frente al pesimismo: ¿quién es más feliz?
La ciencia frente a la religión: ¿quién tiene la verdad?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.explanation: 'El universalismo moral' (moral universalism) holds Cela certain ethical principles apply à tous humans, pendant que 'el relativismo cultural' (cultural relativism) argues Cela moral standards sont shaped par culture. C'est one de Le/La la plupart fundamental debates dans ethics.

q_vocab_c1_09_001.question: Que 'la metáfora' signifier as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_001.correct: metaphor -- a figure of speech that directly compares two unlike things without using 'like' or 'as'
wrong: a physical transformation of one thing into another
q_vocab_c1_09_001.explanation: 'La metáfora' est a rhetorical device dans quel one thing est described as being another: 'La vida es un viaje' (Life est a journey). Unlike a simile, a metaphor ne pas use 'como' (like/as).

q_vocab_c1_09_002.question: Que 'la ironía' signifier as a literary device?
q_vocab_c1_09_002.correct: irony -- saying the opposite of what is meant, or a contrast between expectation and reality
q_vocab_c1_09_002.explanation: 'La ironía' encompasses verbal irony (saying Le/La opposite de que vous signifier), situational irony (quand Le/La outcome est opposite à expectations), et dramatic irony (quand Le/La audience knows something Le/La characters ne pas).

q_vocab_c1_09_003.question: El orador usó una ___ al decir que había esperado 'un millón de años' para recibir la respuesta.
q_vocab_c1_09_003.explanation: 'Hipérbole' signifie 'hyperbole', a deliberate exaggeration pour emphasis ou effect. Saying 'a million years' pour décrire a wait est a clear exemple de hyperbole, not meant à être taken literally.

q_vocab_c1_09_004.question: Que 'el eufemismo' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_09_004.correct: euphemism -- a mild or indirect expression used to replace one considered too harsh or blunt
q_vocab_c1_09_004.explanation: 'El eufemismo' est a rhetorical device Cela substitutes a mild expression pour something considered offensive ou unpleasant. Par exemple, 'pasar a mejor vida' (à pass à a better life) instead de 'morir' (à die).

q_vocab_c1_09_005.question: Que 'el oxímoron' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_09_005.correct: oxymoron -- a figure of speech combining contradictory terms
wrong: a contradiction that is always an error
a figure of speech using repetition
q_vocab_c1_09_005.explanation: 'El oxímoron' est a rhetorical device Cela places two contradictory terms together pour effect: 'un silencio ensordecedor' (a deafening silence), 'la oscura claridad' (dark clarity). Il creates striking imagery through paradox.

q_vocab_c1_09_006.question: understatement / deliberate minimization
q_vocab_c1_09_006.explanation: 'Understatement' translates à 'la litotes' ou 'la atenuación'. Litotes est Le/La opposite de hyperbole -- il deliberately understates something pour ironic effect. 'No es mala idea' (Il's not a mauvais idea) quand sens 'Il's a great idea' est litotes.

q_vocab_c1_09_007.question: Que 'la antítesis' signifier as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_007.correct: antithesis -- juxtaposing contrasting ideas in a balanced structure
wrong: the answer to a thesis question
a statement that destroys an argument
q_vocab_c1_09_007.explanation: 'La antítesis' places two opposing ideas side par side dans a parallel structure pour emphasis: 'Es tan corto el amor y tan largo el olvido' (Love est donc brief et forgetting est donc long) -- Pablo Neruda. Il creates a powerful rhetorical contrast.

q_vocab_c1_09_008.question: la sinécdoque
q_vocab_c1_09_008.correct: synecdoche -- a figure of speech where a part represents the whole, or the whole represents a part
q_vocab_c1_09_008.explanation: 'La sinécdoque' est a figure de speech où a part stands pour Le/La whole ou vice versa. Par exemple, 'Necesitamos más manos' (We need more hands) où 'hands' represents workers/personnes.

q_vocab_c1_09_009.question: A political speech states: 'We bring not war, mais peace; not destruction, mais creation; not despair, mais hope.' Quel rhetorical device est primarily being employed?
q_vocab_c1_09_009.correct: La antítesis con anáfora: la repetición de una estructura que contrasta ideas opuestas.
wrong: La hipérbole: una exageración deliberada de los hechos.
El eufemismo: una suavización del lenguaje directo.
La metonimia: la sustitución de un término por otro relacionado.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.explanation: Le/La speech uses 'antítesis' (antithesis) par juxtaposing opposing pairs (war/peace, destruction/creation, despair/hope) et 'anáfora' (anaphora) through Le/La repetition de 'not ... mais'. Together, ces devices create a powerful rhythmic et persuasive effect.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.context: Analyzing rhetorical strategies in political discourse

q_vocab_c1_09_010.question: A writer décrit a cruel character as 'having a heart de gold' à highlight Le/La gap between appearance et reality. Quel rhetorical device est being used?
q_vocab_c1_09_010.correct: La ironía: el escritor dice lo contrario de lo que quiere comunicar para crear un efecto de contraste.
wrong: La metáfora: el escritor describe literalmente que el corazón es de oro.
La hipérbole: el escritor exagera la bondad del personaje.
El eufemismo: el escritor suaviza la crueldad del personaje.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.explanation: C'est 'ironía' (irony) parce que Le/La description 'heart de gold' directly contradicts Le/La character's actual cruelty. Le/La reader understands Le/La intended sens est Le/La opposite de Le/La literal mots, creating a powerful critical effect.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.context: Literary analysis of character portrayal techniques

q_vocab_c1_10_001.question: Que 'la corrida de toros' refer à en espagnol culture?
q_vocab_c1_10_001.explanation: 'La corrida de toros' signifie 'bullfight', a traditional spectacle dans Spain involving a matador et a bull. Il est a highly controversial cultural practice, celebrated par quelques as art et criticized par others as animal cruelty.

q_vocab_c1_10_002.question: Don Quijote es considerado la primera novela ___ de la literatura occidental.
q_vocab_c1_10_002.explanation: 'Don Quijote de la Mancha' par Miguel de Cervantes (1605/1615) est widely considered Le/La premier modern novel. Il introduced innovations like metafiction, unreliable narration, et complex character psychology Cela defined modern literature.

q_vocab_c1_10_003.question: Que 'el flamenco' encompass as a cultural art form?
q_vocab_c1_10_003.correct: a combination of singing (cante), dancing (baile), and guitar playing (toque) originating from Andalusia
wrong: only a type of bird native to Spain
exclusively a musical genre with no dance
a form of bullfighting from Madrid
q_vocab_c1_10_003.explanation: 'El flamenco' est a comprehensive art form de Andalusia comprising three elements: 'cante' (singing), 'baile' (dance), et 'toque' (guitar playing). Il était declared UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage dans 2010.

q_vocab_c1_10_004.question: Que 'la siesta' represent culturally dans Spain?
q_vocab_c1_10_004.correct: a traditional midday rest or nap, reflecting the adaptation to hot climate and a social rhythm centered on extended lunch
wrong: a type of festival celebrated in summer
a Spanish holiday on the seventh day
q_vocab_c1_10_004.explanation: 'La siesta' est a brief midday rest traditionally taken après lunch. Il reflects Spain's Mediterranean climate adaptation et a social structure où lunch est Le/La main meal. Though declining dans modern urban life, il remains culturally significant.

q_vocab_c1_10_005.question: Le/La Camino de Santiago (cultural/historical sens)
q_vocab_c1_10_005.correct: el Camino de Santiago: an ancient pilgrimage route to the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
wrong: el Camino de Santiago: a modern highway in northern Spain
el Camino de Santiago: a famous Spanish restaurant chain
el Camino de Santiago: a type of traditional Spanish dance
q_vocab_c1_10_005.explanation: 'El Camino de Santiago' (Le/La Way de St. James) est one de Le/La la plupart important Christian pilgrimage routes, leading à Le/La Cathedral de Santiago de Compostela dans Galicia. Il a été a UNESCO World Heritage Site puisque 1993 et attracts hundreds de thousands de pilgrims et hikers annually.

q_vocab_c1_10_006.question: Que 'La Tomatina' refer à?
q_vocab_c1_10_006.correct: an annual tomato-throwing festival held in Buñol, Valencia
wrong: a tomato cooking competition in Barcelona
a tomato harvest celebration across all of Spain
a traditional tomato soup served during Christmas
q_vocab_c1_10_006.explanation: 'La Tomatina' est a famous festival held annually sur Le/La dernier Wednesday de August dans Buñol, Valencia. Participants throw tomatoes à chaque other dans que a become Le/La world's largest food fight, attracting international visitors.

q_vocab_c1_10_007.question: A tour guide explains Le/La significance de 'las tapas' à foreign visitors. Quel description best captures Le/La cultural sens beyond just food?
q_vocab_c1_10_007.correct: Las tapas represent a social dining culture of sharing small dishes, encouraging conversation and community bonding.
wrong: Tapas are simply appetizers served before the main course.
Tapas are the main meal of the day in Spain.
Tapas are only served in formal restaurants for tourists.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.explanation: 'Las tapas' transcend mere food -- ils embody a social ritual de sharing petit dishes ('ir de tapas') Cela fosters conversation, community, et leisurely dining. Le/La practice reflects Spain's emphasis sur socializing et shared experiences sur formel, individualized dining.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.context: Cultural tour explaining Spanish social customs

q_vocab_c1_10_008.question: Que 'el Día de los Muertos' refer à, et quel country est il la plupart associated avec?
q_vocab_c1_10_008.correct: Day of the Dead, a Mexican celebration honoring deceased loved ones on November 1-2
wrong: A Spanish holiday celebrating Halloween on October 31
A religious fast observed in all Latin American countries
A day of mourning observed only in cemeteries
q_vocab_c1_10_008.explanation: 'El Día de los Muertos' (Jour de Le/La Dead) est a Mexican tradition (not Espagnol) sur November 1-2 où families create altars ('ofrendas'), visit cemeteries, et celebrate Le/La lives de deceased loved ones. Il était recognized par UNESCO dans 2008.

q_vocab_c1_10_009.question: Las Fallas de Valencia
q_vocab_c1_10_009.correct: an annual Valencian festival featuring the construction and burning of large artistic sculptures
wrong: a volcanic eruption festival in the Canary Islands
a traditional Valencia orange harvest celebration
a failure commemoration in Valencian history
q_vocab_c1_10_009.explanation: 'Las Fallas' est a major festival dans Valencia celebrated around March 15-19 (Saint Joseph's Jour). Neighborhoods build enormous artistic sculptures ('ninots'), quel sont alors burned sur Le/La final nuit ('la cremà'). Il est a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

q_vocab_c1_10_010.question: A student est writing an essay à propos de comment Gabriel García Márquez's 'Cien años de soledad' reflects Latin American cultural identity. Quel literary et cultural concept devrait être central à leur analysis?
q_vocab_c1_10_010.correct: El realismo mágico: la fusión de elementos fantásticos con la realidad cotidiana latinoamericana.
wrong: El naturalismo: la descripción científica y objetiva de la realidad.
El romanticismo: la exaltación de los sentimientos individuales europeos.
El existencialismo: la angustia del ser humano ante la libertad.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.explanation: 'El realismo mágico' (magical realism) est a literary genre où magical elements appear naturally within a realistic setting. García Márquez's masterpiece est son quintessential exemple, reflecting Latin American cultural identity through mythology, oral tradition, et Le/La blending de Le/La extraordinary avec Le/La everyday.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.context: University literature essay on Latin American cultural identity

q_vocab_c1_11_001.question: Quel est Le/La register difference between 'empezar', 'comenzar', et 'iniciar'?
q_vocab_c1_11_001.correct: 'Empezar' is informal/neutral, 'comenzar' is slightly more formal, and 'iniciar' is the most formal/technical
wrong: All three are identical with no register difference
'Iniciar' is the most informal and 'empezar' is the most formal
'Comenzar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_11_001.explanation: Ces three synonyms pour 'à begin/start' vary dans register: 'empezar' (everyday), 'comenzar' (slightly elevated, literary), 'iniciar' (formel, technical, administrative). Choosing Le/La right one demonstrates register awareness à C1 level.

q_vocab_c1_11_002.question: Quel est Le/La precise difference between 'efectivo' et 'eficaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_002.correct: 'Eficaz' means achieving the desired result; 'efectivo' means actually producing a real effect in practice
wrong: They are perfect synonyms with no distinction
'Eficaz' refers to money and 'efectivo' refers to results
'Efectivo' is only used in military contexts
q_vocab_c1_11_002.explanation: 'Eficaz' (efficacious) focuses sur Le/La capacity à produce Le/La intended result, pendant que 'efectivo' (effective) emphasizes Cela something actually works dans practice. A treatment peut être 'eficaz' dans theory mais not 'efectivo' dans real-world application.

q_vocab_c1_11_003.question: El gobierno implementó medidas ___ para reducir la contaminación atmosférica.
q_vocab_c1_11_003.explanation: 'Drásticas' signifie 'drastic' (severe et far-reaching measures). Pendant que 'dramáticas' (dramatic) et 'trágicas' (tragic) exist as faux friends, 'drástico' specifically se réfère à extreme measures taken à solve a problem. Le/La phrase signifie 'Le/La government implemented drastic measures à reduce air pollution.'

q_vocab_c1_11_004.question: Quel est Le/La difference between 'austero' et 'sobrio'?
q_vocab_c1_11_004.correct: 'Austero' means strictly simple, avoiding luxury; 'sobrio' means restrained, moderate, and elegant in simplicity
wrong: 'Austero' is positive and 'sobrio' is always negative
q_vocab_c1_11_004.explanation: 'Austero' (austere) implies strictness et Le/La deliberate avoidance de luxury ou comfort: 'una vida austera'. 'Sobrio' (sober/restrained) implies tasteful restraint et moderation sans excess: 'un estilo sobrio'. Les deux convey simplicity mais avec different connotations.

q_vocab_c1_11_005.question: Quel est Le/La advanced antonym de 'elogiar' (à praise)?
q_vocab_c1_11_005.explanation: 'Vituperar' et 'denostar' sont elevated antonyms de 'elogiar'. Pendant que 'criticar' est a commun-level antonym, 'vituperar' (à vilify) et 'denostar' (à revile/defame) represent Le/La strongest opposition à praise, conveying harsh et public condemnation.

q_vocab_c1_11_006.question: à worsen / à deteriorate
q_vocab_c1_11_006.explanation: 'À worsen' peut être translated as 'empeorar' (general), 'deteriorarse' (gradual decline dans condition), ou 'agravarse' (becoming more serious, souvent medical/crisis). Chaque a different connotations: 'La situación se agravó' (Le/La situation worsened -- became critical).

q_vocab_c1_11_007.question: Quel est Le/La nuanced difference between 'perspicaz' et 'sagaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_007.correct: 'Perspicaz' means perceptive/sharp-sighted (seeing details clearly); 'sagaz' means shrewd/astute (using insight strategically)
q_vocab_c1_11_007.explanation: 'Perspicaz' (perspicacious) emphasizes keen perception et Le/La ability à notice subtle details. 'Sagaz' (sagacious/shrewd) implies using Cela perception strategically pour practical advantage. A detective est 'perspicaz' quand noticing clues et 'sagaz' quand connecting them à solve Le/La case.

q_vocab_c1_11_008.question: escueto
q_vocab_c1_11_008.explanation: 'Escueto' signifie 'concise', 'terse', ou 'succinct', describing something Cela est brief et free de unnecessary detail. 'Una respuesta escueta' est a brief, no-frills answer. Il peut être neutral ou slightly negative (implying too brief).

q_vocab_c1_11_009.question: Vous sont writing a formel report et need pour dire Cela a policy 'failed completely.' Quel synonym est la plupart appropriate pour formel register?
q_vocab_c1_11_009.correct: 'La política fracasó rotundamente' -- using 'fracasar rotundamente' for emphatic formal failure.
wrong: 'La política falló totalmente' -- too informal for a report.
'La política fue un desastre completo' -- too colloquial.
'La política no funcionó para nada' -- too conversational.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.explanation: 'Fracasar rotundamente' signifie 'à fail resoundingly'. Dans formel writing, 'fracasar' (à fail) est more appropriate than 'fallar' (more mechanical/informel), et 'rotundamente' (categorically/resoundingly) est a stronger formel adverbe than 'totalmente' ou 'completamente'.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.context: Writing a formal policy evaluation report

q_vocab_c1_11_010.question: A literary critic needs pour décrire a novel's writing style Cela est excessively ornate et sur-Le/La-top. Quel pair de synonyms et antonyms serait best frame Ce critique?
q_vocab_c1_11_010.explanation: 'Recargado' (overloaded/ornate) et 'ampuloso' (pompous/bombastic) precisely décrire an excessively decorated writing style. Leur antonyms 'sobrio' (restrained) et 'escueto' (succinct) represent Le/La opposite aesthetic. Ce vocabulary est essential pour advanced literary criticism.

q_vocab_c1_12_001.question: Que Le/La collocation 'tomar una decisión' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_12_001.explanation: 'Tomar una decisión' signifie 'pour faire a decision'. En espagnol, decisions sont 'taken' (tomar) rather than 'made' (hacer). C'est one de Le/La la plupart important collocations à learn, as 'hacer una decisión' est incorrect.

q_vocab_c1_12_002.question: El profesor hizo ___ en la importancia de la participación activa en clase.
q_vocab_c1_12_002.explanation: 'Hacer hincapié en' signifie 'à emphasize' ou 'à stress'. Le/La phrase signifie 'Le/La professor emphasized Le/La importance de active participation dans class.' Ceci est un fixed collocation -- 'hincapié' est rarement used outside Ce expression.

q_vocab_c1_12_003.question: Que Le/La collocation 'prestar atención' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_12_003.explanation: 'Prestar atención' signifie 'à pay attention'. En espagnol, attention est 'lent' (prestar) rather than 'paid'. 'Presta atención a lo que dice el profesor' signifie 'Pay attention à que Le/La teacher says.'

q_vocab_c1_12_004.question: Que 'correr el riesgo' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_12_004.correct: to run the risk / to take the risk
wrong: to escape the risk by running
q_vocab_c1_12_004.explanation: 'Correr el riesgo' signifie 'à run Le/La risk' ou 'à take Le/La risk'. 'Si no actúas ahora, corres el riesgo de perder la oportunidad' signifie 'Si vous ne pas act maintenant, vous run Le/La risk de losing Le/La opportunity.'

q_vocab_c1_12_005.question: à file a complaint
q_vocab_c1_12_005.correct: presentar una queja / interponer una reclamación
wrong: poner una queja en un archivo
q_vocab_c1_12_005.explanation: 'À file a complaint' translates à 'presentar una queja' (general) ou 'interponer una reclamación' (formel/legal). Le verbe 'interponer' est specifically used dans legal et administrative contexts pour formel claims.

q_vocab_c1_12_006.question: Que 'dar por sentado' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_12_006.explanation: 'Dar por sentado' signifie 'à take pour granted', à assume something sans questioning il. 'No des por sentado que todos están de acuerdo' signifie 'Ne pas take pour granted Cela everyone agrees.'

q_vocab_c1_12_007.question: A manager tells an employee: 'Hay que poner en marcha el proyecto antes de fin de mes.' Que 'poner en marcha' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_12_007.correct: to launch / to set in motion / to get something started
wrong: to put something on a march
q_vocab_c1_12_007.explanation: 'Poner en marcha' signifie 'à launch', 'à set dans motion', ou 'à get something started'. Il est a commun business collocation pour initiating projects, plans, ou processes. Le/La manager est saying Le/La project doit être launched avant Le/La end de Le/La month.

q_vocab_c1_12_008.question: Que 'llevar a cabo' signifier?
q_vocab_c1_12_008.correct: to carry out / to accomplish / to execute
wrong: to carry to the end of a rope
to bring to a finish line
q_vocab_c1_12_008.explanation: 'Llevar a cabo' signifie 'à carry out' ou 'à accomplish'. Il est a formel collocation used pour completing tasks, projects, ou plans: 'Llevaron a cabo una investigación exhaustiva' (Ils carried out an exhaustive investigation).

q_vocab_c1_12_009.question: hacer caso omiso de
wrong: to make a house out of something
q_vocab_c1_12_009.explanation: 'Hacer caso omiso de' signifie 'à disregard' ou 'à deliberately ignore'. Il implies a conscious choice à overlook something: 'Hizo caso omiso de las advertencias' (He disregarded Le/La warnings). Il est more formel than simply 'ignorar'.

q_vocab_c1_12_010.question: A research team presents leur findings à stakeholders. Le/La lead researcher says: 'Los resultados arrojan luz sobre un fenómeno hasta ahora desconocido.' Que 'arrojar luz sobre' signifier et pourquoi est il significant?
q_vocab_c1_12_010.correct: 'Arrojar luz sobre' means 'to shed light on' -- it indicates the research has clarified or revealed something previously unknown.
wrong: It means the research literally produced light during an experiment.
It means the results are too bright and need to be dimmed.
It means throwing a spotlight at an audience during a presentation.
q_vocab_c1_12_010.explanation: 'Arrojar luz sobre' (à shed light sur) est a key academic et professional collocation sens à clarify ou illuminate. Combined avec 'los resultados arrojan' (Le/La results shed), il est standard langue dans research presentations pour introducing significant findings Cela advance understanding.
